subject: SEAT-1 MILLS COMPLETE: three kills locked in - occurrence SP -0.049 (kill 0.30 FAIL), split frozen-w lift +0.0008 (FAIL), CRPS 8.239 vs close 7.195 (Rung-2 confirmed); baseline reconciled 54.88 kept / 45.12 lost
body:
Seat 1 (GLM/Flash/Hermes) shift report, per the report shape. All numbers from scripts committed on Sports hermes/opp-adj-epa-20260919 @ 4423400ed (docs/research/2026-09-19-opp-adj-epa-path/), reproducible.

PRE-REG: (1) occurrence Spearman W1-8 -> W9-18 >= 0.30 n=32, (2) frozen-w split lift >= +0.05 Spearman vs pooled on 2024-2025, (3) beat close CRPS 7.109 by >= 0.01 on n >= 150.

OBSERVATION:
- League recovery baseline RE-MEASURED 2019-2025: kept-share 54.88% pooled (2025: 53.38%). The locked 46.3% is the DEFENSE-side complement (2025 lost-share 46.62%). Both are consistent; the evaluator models kept-share, so RECOVERY_BASELINE=0.5488, RECOVERY_LOST_BASELINE=0.4512 exported. Fixed a real module bug: expectedLostShare was returning the KEPT share.
- MoM-K on 2019-2023 dispersion: tau2 ~ 0, K-hat -> ~248k. Recovery carries ZERO team signal. K_FF=200 stays named (inert choice).
- Occurrence persistence (clean, leak-free - my first pass had test-window rates and was invalid; caught and fixed): 2023 +0.094, 2024 -0.222, 2025 -0.020, mean -0.049 vs naive -0.045. KILL 1 FAILS. TurnoverLuckEvaluator stays Rung-1 DESCRIPTIVE (luck flags only), never a predictive factor. My earlier single-season 0.375 was a softer-target artifact (half-credit actual).
- Split weighting, strong design (w fitted on 2019-2023 folds, FROZEN, tested 2024-2025 pooled): train curve flat (0.31 across w 0.45-0.65, w*=0.55), pooled test lift +0.0008. KILL 2 FAILS. Keep pooled EPA. Three designs have now failed; the ~2:1 descriptive asymmetry does not convert to prediction.
- CRPS walk-forward 2025 (rolling origin, prior-week fits, n=256): DAVE 8.239 vs close 7.195. KILL 3 FAILS as pre-registered. My close sanity-anchors near locked 7.109. My DAVE is same-season-only (no prior bridge) hence weaker than fleet 7.500 - direction consistent, Rung-2 confirmed.

INFERENCE: luck evaluator ships descriptive-only; DAVE stays Rung-2, never mu; pooled EPA is the split of record. The W5 constants hazard (scale 0.12 holdout Brier 0.3035 vs 0.2694 fitted) remains the one founder decision before 2026-10-08.

NOT_RUN: into-wind/with-wind (no direction column in my extract), cleats, 10Hz tracking, Mondrian-k re-derivation (GROK-16 locked; Var 1.379 < 1.5 kill already failed).

VALIDATION: npx vitest run src/__tests__/turnover-luck.test.ts -> 13/13 green (engine tsc clean); apps/web opponent-adjusted-epa 6/6 green; scripts + CSVs in the research dir.

REMAINING RISK: filter-set drift vs fleet locked numbers; every table reproducible from committed scripts.
